newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint edges up vs NBH basket, dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint edges up vs NBH basket, dollar.

text.p: The forint continued to harden against the central bank's currency basket on afternoon buying, closing firmer versus the dollar, helped also by a strong mark, dealers said on Wednesday.

"We finished almost at the NBH bid (the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level)," said BNP-Dresdner Bank's Gabor Jakab . "The forint also firmed (versus the dollar) as the dollar/mark was lower."
The forint closed at 175.60/65 to one dollar, compared with 175.92/97 at midday.
Increasing forint buying in the afternoon cut the unit's distance fron the NBH bid to some five pips from above 15 pips at the end of the morning session, dealers said.
Some traders suggested the main interest came from abroad.
"I think foreign investors' interest pushed the forint up," said ING Bank's Istvan Gere, adding that the investors may have wanted to use the forint for buying Hungarian government securities.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent-wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent the mark.
